148625.overview: Cavern Attack is a side view scrolling game where you control a submarine, moving up or down, to destroy as many monsters as you can. The screen scrolls constantly from left to right and you must avoid touching the sides of the cavern as you ram the monsters. The monsters have spat out torpedoes and these need avoiding and if you touch one or the sides of the cavern, then it is game over. There is an option to play a Slow or Fast game.

148626.overview: Centipede is based on the arcade game where you control a craft at the bottom of the screen and blast a Centipede at the top of the screen, moving across the screen and downwards when it hits the edge of the screen or a mushroom. When you hit the Centipede it splits into two and moves in different directions, and hitting the new Centipedes creates more moving across the screen. Blasting mushrooms give you bonus points and you are able to move forwards up the screen a short distance. If you are touched by any part of the Centipede then you lose one of three lives.

148629.overview: A  basic but fairly accurate for the time of release version of chess for the Jupiter Ace computer.

148630.overview:
The deep space cargo vessel, Cygnus has been attacked by pirates from the planet Retipujeca who have killed all the crew and stolen all the cargo. As the incident was in your sector, you the leader of a Galaxy Patrol squad must board the vessel to investigate what happened on board. As the boarding hatch is damaged, and the only way to enter is with a backpack, you have also decided to go alone and to also prove your worth as a leader.

Cygnus is an arcade adventure where you must investigate three floors of the vessel, with each floor shown on the whole screen from above. You must move from room to room as quick as possible as there is only a limited supply of oxygen. Objects like keys can be found and used elsewhere on the vessel. Also on board are robots which move around the vessel and will shoot at anyone on board and if you are shot, touch a robot or run out of air, then it is game over.
